description:
**fuzzel** is a fast application launcher for Wayland, running natively on your jailbroken device on the iosc Wayland compositor.

This is a real native arm64 binary cross-compiled for rootless iOS. Built around the wlr layer-shell protocol, fuzzel appears as an overlay, filters your applications as you type, and launches the one you pick.

- Native Wayland launcher via the wlr layer-shell protocol
- Fuzzy matching with instant filtering
- Reads desktop entries and shows their icons
- fcft text rendering for crisp labels

Built for iPadOS/iOS rootless (palera1n/Dopamine, `/var/jb`). Launch it inside an Xios desktop session running the iosc compositor.

changelog.notes:
- First release: fuzzel 1.12.0 cross-compiled for rootless iOS
- Wayland layer-shell application launcher on the iosc compositor
